verdict.rationale:
CrewAI's core is a locally installable Python package (`uv tool install crewai`) with a CLI to create/run/manage crews entirely on the user's own machine, and its GitHub repo confirms it as an open-source project independent of the hosted AMP/Enterprise offering. This clearly satisfies self-hosting the core product for an AI-native user comfortable with CLI/code.
Missing for 10: explicit license statement, production self-hosting/deployment guidance (e.g., Docker, server setup) beyond local dev install, and independent confirmation of full feature parity when self-hosted vs. hosted enterprise tier.
